{{Top|leg}}
The '''squad recovery stim''' was a unique kind of [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] that included a number of fittings to be placed on every member of the group (automatically done at purchase). When activated, a [[stim-shot]] was activated that healed everyone in the squad. This unit also included optional electro-stim fittings that prompted the auto-repair functions of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] group members.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
